We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction described (Still-Gennari). We have previous step: make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 gave precursors list: two SMILES strings: precursor1 "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" and precursor2 "CCC(CC)C(=O)OC(=O)/C=C/C=C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O". So the template applied to target molecule gave those precursors. We need to find the template that was used. The previous task make_5_lvl2-template_search-4 likely searched for template. We need to retrieve template_id and mapped_rxn (reaction SMILES with atom mapping). We can maybe use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional groups formed/broken etc. But we have the target molecule? Not given directly. The target molecule is the product of Still-Gennari reaction? The precursors are a phosphonate ester and an aldehyde? The first precursor looks like a sugar derivative? Actually "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" is maybe a phosphonate? Not sure. The second is "CCC(CC)C(=O)OC(=O)/C=C/C=C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O" looks like a polyunsaturated acid ester.

We need to find template that matches transformation: carbon-carbon double bond formed, carboxylic ester formed, etc. Could search with criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "alkene", "carboxylic_ester". functional_groups_broken includes maybe "alkyne"? Actually triple bond changed to single. So broken functional group "alkyne". Also broken bonds: C-P, C-C, C-O. Formed bonds: C=C, C-O (ester). But we may not need to be precise; we can try search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed ["alkene","carboxylic_ester"], functional_groups_broken ["alkyne"].

Let's try.
